case_number: 2024 INSC 361; CIVIL APPEAL NO(S). 1842 OF 2024 (ARISING OUT OF SLP(C) NO. 396 OF 2019)

parties.respondent: The New India Assurance Company & Anr.

summary: Motor accident compensation jurisdiction dispute; territorial jurisdiction determination under MV Act s.166; insurance company presence sufficient for tribunal jurisdiction; CPC s.21 interpretation; claimant residence vs accident site relevance; Malati Sardar precedent application; hyper-technical objections disfavored; accident occurred in Udham Singh Nagar but claim filed at Nainital where insurer had office.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; matter remanded to tribunal for decision on merits regarding compensation.
